create_CustomTensorboardWriter: create a CustomTensorboardWriter instance with a log directory for distributed training logging
add_scalar_metrics: add scalar metrics to TensorBoard with a prefix and training step using add_scalar
add_multiple_scalars: add multiple scalar metrics to TensorBoard grouped under a prefix with a single call to add_scalars
log_hyperparameters: log hyperparameters and corresponding evaluation metrics to TensorBoard using add_hparams
log_images_and_videos: log images and videos to TensorBoard during training using add_image and add_video methods
